pages.text: Three enchantment sets auto-register per damage type at launch (8 types x 3 = 24):$(br)$(#3CB371)protect_<type>$() - armor resistance, 5%/level$(br)$(#CD5C5C)strike_<type>$() - weapon bonus, 10%/level$(br)$(#7B68EE)projectile_strike_<type>$() - projectile-only items (arrows)$(br2)$(bold)Level Decoupled$(): max_enchant_level defaults to 255. Anvil-combined or command-granted levels beyond 4 work normally via the linear formula. Enchanting tables still cap at 4 (vanilla limit).

Vanilla arrows can't normally be enchanted - the mod $(o)takes over anvil merging$() for projectiles.$(br2)Enchanted tooltips show $(2)(with enchantments)$() and green bonus values.$(br2)$(4)Note$(): enchantments freeze at launch; new damage types need a $(o)restart$() to generate them.
